continuous_profile_bound.proof: At every insertion depth the male radius is at most its stem radius. Every engaging wall/tube/post leaves at least reference-radius plus female RADIAL clearance; the bottom entry expands that space monotonically. Half-pitch ribs remain outside that envelope. The cavity ceiling is higher than the seated stud tip. Body bottoms never descend below the lower roof.
continuous_profile_bound.scope: Matched, aligned owned cells; pure vertical rigid translation; no deformation or retention claim

check.contact_interpretation: Positive clearance means NO radial wall/tube contact before elastic deformation; only bearing faces contact. At zero clearance there is nominal tangency. Negative clearance intentionally produces interference. Studs enter the spaces OUTSIDE between-stud tubes, not their bores.

print_assumptions.scope: A bounded subset of grippable 2x2/2x4 bricks and representative plates; fit candidates only
print_assumptions.nozzle_note: 0.4 mm is a candidate for these larger bricks, not a claim that it is currently installed. Confirm actual nozzle/profile on the other PC.

label_legend.thin_2x4_plate: Nominal 3.2 mm body / 1.0 mm roof; no side notch
label_legend.notch_height: Entire body height; not microscopic lettering

instructions: These are uncalibrated prototype studies, not print approval. Physical fit and retention remain UNKNOWN.
The plate contains one each of three male 2x2 variants, five female 2x4 variants, and one nominal 2x4 plate: nine pieces, not a 45-piece cross-product.
All nine open undersides face DOWN, top studs face UP, and body bottoms are at z=0.
Count full-height side notches separately within the 2x2 male and 2x4 female families; consult the numeric legend.
Male variants change stem DIAMETER only. Female variants change RADIAL wall/tube/post clearance, never the top-stud diameter.
Align the 2x2 male to the middle four cells under the 2x4 receiver and lower the receiver vertically until its bottom bears on the lower roof.
Negative radial clearance and the largest male against the nominal female intentionally interfere. Do not force an untested tight pair.
The tube bore is NOT the receiving hole for a stud; studs engage spaces between perimeter walls and tube OUTSIDES.
The last reported installed nozzle is 0.2 mm. The owned 0.4 mm nozzle is a comparison candidate, not claimed installed.
P1S 256x256 mm, 10 mm border and 3 mm spacing are geometric assumptions. No slicer/profile/support/layer/time/mass validation, G-code, printer connection, Print or Send was performed.
In the native document export only ExportOnlyNinePiecePlate for this layout, not hidden construction objects or the prototype tree.
